lines.zh: 灰色的身体像一小截树皮。
lines.en: My grey body looks like a strip of bark.
I inch along the twig.
Arching and straightening, I advance.
My grey flecks blur into the bark.
Hind feet anchor first.
Every inch needs testing first.
Up the stem, onto the blade.
Holes follow my path.

lines.zh: 我加快了一点，去向阳处。
lines.en: A bit faster, toward the sun.
I keep to the veins.

lines.zh: 一只蚂蚁从旁边过去了。
lines.en: An ant went by me.
I turn and go under the branch.
Creeping along the leaf's underside.
I stop where the twig forks.

lines.zh: 灰色的皮皱成一节一节。
lines.en: My grey skin wrinkles into segments.
I squeeze through a gap.

lines.zh: 我伪装成树皮上的一块。
lines.en: I'm pretending to be a patch of bark.

lines.zh: 灰斑在光下几乎看不出。
lines.en: My grey flecks vanish in the light.
I chew all day long.
Hanging under the branch like this.
The missing leaf bit is me.
Waiting for the light to fade.

lines.zh: 我的身体没有什么力气。
lines.en: I've no strength in me.
Leaves are tenderest after rain.
Still as a dead twig.

lines.zh: 风把我的身体吹得轻晃。
lines.en: The wind rocks me gently.
This is my third molt.
I must eat until I can pupate.
You have sharp eyes.
I make a decent twig, don't I.
The leaf you're blocking is tender.

lines.zh: 我身上只有灰斑和叶子渣。
lines.en: Grey flecks and leaf crumbs are all I have.
Are you picking this branch?
Don't pinch me like a bug.
I've been on this tree a while.
Grey is my whole fortune.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我的叶上。
lines.en: Your shadow falls across my leaf.
You're close. I'm a bit afraid.
A tear in my grey skin.
I curled into a bent segment.
I slid off the leaf.
Leaf pulp leaks from my mouth.
Pain stretched me straight.

lines.zh: 我的灰皮上塌下去一小块。
lines.en: A small dent sinks into my grey skin.
I cling to the node and stay still.
Part of me has darkened.
I can still crawl, slowly.
Please don't do that again.
Leaves. Nothing else will do.
Has that leaf been chewed already?
That leaf you picked is too old.
Lower it so I can climb on.
Not fruit. Leaves only.
This leaf smells of sunlight.

lines.zh: 你要是摘光了，我吃什么。
lines.en: If you strip it all, what do I eat?
I don't want to leave this tree.
Don't offer me anything thorny.
A small piece is plenty.
The twig lurches; my front feet let go.
You pressed the twig down.
My feet tangled on the stem.
Some grey skin got rubbed off.
Please don't shake this tree.
I slipped on the leaf.
You're between me and the leaf.
I'm moving to the far side.
That touch made me shrink.
Move back a little. I need to eat.
I'm still in my leaf-eating stage.
Grey won't hide how small I am.
Wait till I'm something else.
You shouldn't ask me this.
I haven't thought as far as tomorrow.
There are plenty of caterpillars here.
I'm not that old yet.
Let me eat my fill first.
I don't know those words.
I turn and burrow under the leaf.
This would do for camouflage.
In the mouth, then back out.
I push it onto the leaf.
Not a leaf. I won't touch it.
Picking that up for me? On the leaf.
It grates my teeth. I spit it out.
I hook onto it and climb.
It smells of your hands.
I hold it and think a moment.
Just leave this on the branch.
A shadow flickered over there.
I've stretched myself straight.
Something landed on the branch.

lines.zh: 我听见的不是翅膀，是靴底。
lines.en: What I hear is not wings but a boot sole.
That's not a bird. Too big.
I duck into the gap by the stem.
This is when grey helps.
Flattened against the underside.
It landed on the next branch.
I'm making myself as narrow as I can.
That thing still hasn't left.
Hanging like a dead twig.
Its shadow is over me.
I hold still and don't breathe.
The twig hides most of me.
It's probably only passing by.
I've pulled my head in.
In the wind my grey looks like bark.
Just hold on a little longer.
It turned and flew off.
I butted with my head.
I bite your finger.
I twist and bump into you.
I spat out leaf pulp.
That had no weight to it.
I slipped off the twig.
I wrap your finger and hold.
When your hand lifts, I dangle.
This is all the struggle I have.
I dropped onto your shoe.
I came out of a grey egg.

lines.zh: 叶子上有一层薄薄的雾。
lines.en: A thin mist lies on the leaves.
First I chewed a small opening.
My grey skin hasn't hardened.
I climb down the branch.
The light deep in the jungle is scattered.
I've found my first leaf.
I breathe along with the bark.
I begin growing, bit by bit.
Water still clings to the leaves.
The leaf edge caught fire and my grey skin burned.

lines.zh: 整根枝断了，我一起掉下去。
lines.en: The whole twig broke and I fell with it.
Water pinned me against the leaf.

lines.zh: 爆炸把树皮和叶都掀开。
lines.en: The blast peeled off bark and leaves.

lines.zh: 有东西穿过叶子钉住了我。
lines.en: Something pierced the leaf and pinned me.

lines.zh: 咒光让我的伪装全失效。
lines.en: The spell-light ruined my camouflage.

lines.zh: 这枝叶吃空了，我饿得发慌。
lines.en: This twig's bare. I'm frantic with hunger.

lines.zh: 雷顺着树干下来，我的节都僵了。
lines.en: Lightning runs down the trunk; every segment locks.

lines.zh: 我在黑暗里翻滚，找不到叶。
lines.en: Tumbling in the dark, no leaf anywhere.
